blocks.head: alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
alt UserX is near the device
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device and ImmediateRelayUser is near the device
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device, CachingRelayUser is near the device, and CachingRelayUser has no cached command
alt CachingRelayUser is near the device and has cached command L
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by share and UserY
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by revoke and UserY

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | ('cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > < UserY | (.....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ......) > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (Device ; UserY) 
= < cloudA | ('cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > < UserY | (.....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , ......) > $ cloudA 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY) .

eq < cloudA | ('cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ...) , ....) > < UserX | (.....) > < UserY | (......) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , .......) > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (Device ; UserY) 
= < cloudA | ('cloudKey' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ....) > < UserX | (.....) > < UserY | (......) > < RelayUser | ('near' : Device , .......) > $ cloudA 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .

eq < RelayUser | (..) > < ImmediateRelayUser | ('near' : Device , ...) > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; L) 
= < RelayUser | (..) > < ImmediateRelayUser | ('near' : Device , ...) > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'deliverCommand' CachingRelayUser | (Device ; L) 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('cachedCommand' : L , ..) > .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ..) > 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L) .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ..) > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY) 
= < Device | ('trusted' : (Trusted , UserY) , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('trusted' : (Trusted , UserY) , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ..) > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth', Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY) 
= < Device | ('trusted' : Trusted , 'cloudKey' : Secret , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Device) @ S < UserX | ('near' : Device , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, deviceB, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, deviceB, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .
